images.name: Pelvis_Rear
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated hand-painted 2D cutout attachment for our original Unity character Kael. Image 1 is the reference for identity/materials, image 2 is the FRONT attachment to turn around. Preserve the original charcoal-black cloth/leather, muted ivory silver trim, warm anime cel-painted shading and clear dark outline. Produce a TRUE THREE-QUARTER REAR VIEW, the unseen backs of the same clothes, while the character faces away and slightly toward screen RIGHT. This must look anatomically like a BACK, not a mirrored front. Single centered isolated part, generous empty transparent margin, upright neutral rest orientation, genuine transparent RGBA background. No complete character, no scenery, no labels, no text, no shadow on a ground plane. Paint solid closed overlapping ends for animation joints; no open tubular holes, no disembodied flesh, no circular joint diagrams. Keep proportions and style; no new costume design.
Turn only the waist and pelvis/short upper trouser hip panel into its actual REAR view. Clearly show the rear of crimson wrap sash and dark rear trouser seat, with simple back seams and lateral dark leather belt continuation. Absolutely NO front diamond buckle, NO front dangling sash end in the center, NO crotch fly, NO long coat tails (those are separate attachments). Horizontal waistline at top, rear seat below and two rounded fabric overlaps at lower hip sockets. Compact wide silhouette similar to the input pelvis.
